rationale: A stable-level status passes through two dst_clk stages that carry ASYNC_REG consistently and have no early fan-out. The contract accepts two cycles of latency.
caveats: Expect CDC-029 INFO (recognised chain) and no CDC-012 finding, since all stages carry the attribute. Under the proposed label's expected_rules, CDC-003 is an INFO recognition, not an expected finding.

No whole-IP clean premise. Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
Physical MTBF and placement are external.
